definition: Every real, dated, live access attempt made against the sources behind P40's selected first tranche (data/p40/p41-tranche-contract.json), using two independent methods (WebFetch and a direct curl cross-check) so a result is never attributed to a single tool's own quirk. This is P41's own required 'source and access-attempt record' output, kept whether or not it produces a numeric promotion.
